name: 15963 · Windber, PA
findings: ZIP 15963 (Windber) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15963 (Windber) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
